t: What do I need to open an account?
d: Your Ghana Card, two passport photographs and your GhanaPost GPS address. Some accounts need more: for a child you also need their birth certificate, and businesses need their registration documents.

t: Can I use my account at any branch?
d: Yes. All our branches and mobilisation centres are networked, so you can deposit and withdraw at any of them.

t: Do I need to update my records with my Ghana Card?
d: Yes. Since July 2022 the Ghana Card is the only identification accepted for banking. If you have not linked yours, visit any branch with your card.

t: My account has been inactive for years. What happens?
d: Under the Banks and Specialised Deposit-Taking Institutions Act, 2016 (Act 930), accounts not used for five years become dormant and are listed in our dormant accounts register, then transferred to the Bank of Ghana. Visit a branch with your Ghana Card to reactivate yours.

t: How long does a loan decision take?

d: It depends on the loan. Salary Loans are secured by your salary, Group Loans by the group guarantee, and larger business loans may need collateral.
U-Connect is our mobile banking app. Check your balance, transfer money and pay bills from your phone.

t: Can I use MTN Mobile Money with my account?
d: Yes. We are an MTN Mobile Money super merchant. Ask at any branch to link your account and wallet.

t: How do I make a complaint?
d: Speak to the branch manager, call our hotline or use the complaints form. See the complaints page for how we handle it and how long it takes.

t: Will the bank ever ask for my PIN?
d: Never. We will never ask for your PIN, password or full card number by phone, SMS, WhatsApp or email. If someone does, it is a fraud. Hang up and call us.
